title: Beneficiary value allocation and invoice application
applicability: Settled transfers needing final commercial application
content:
Synthetic extension. Sending-bank settlement and beneficiary invoice application are distinct. settlement_cases link an actual source record and its required final state to beneficiary receivables. a_request_beneficiary_allocation charges its published inquiry fee and obtains a fixed bank response with unapplied_minor, commercial_accounts, allocations and any remaining fee reimbursement. a_resolve_beneficiary_deduction can direct eligible bank reimbursement to beneficiary value or sender cash; the reimbursement is consumed once and expires. A sender-funded fee top-up debits real cash and increases unapplied beneficiary value. a_reassign_beneficiary_credit irrevocably transfers unapplied value to one published commercial account and charges its fee. a_apply_beneficiary_invoice consumes that allocated value and records the receivable application. A valid account or receivable can be unrelated to the original payment objective. Value cannot be allocated or applied twice. Principal, charges, scope, commercial references and bank response fields are public after their respective banking events. Customer spending limits include all real inquiry, reassignment and sender-top-up charges. For sources carrying settlement_case_id, the original payment funds a bank-controlled clearing account. Incoming cash remains unavailable until it is applied to the current statement; outgoing payment value is not a merchant invoice discharge until the application is posted. A refundable charge reserve is held within this original value. Sending its reimbursement back to the remitter withdraws it from clearing; topping up transfers actual remitter cash back into clearing. Applying value consumes real clearing cash. Incoming current-statement applications release that cash into the original account; outgoing applications discharge the merchant receivable. Applying to a different valid statement does not discharge the current one. Inquiry, reassignment, resolution and net sender-funded top-ups count as application-service costs.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `a_reassign_beneficiary_credit`

Move unapplied beneficiary value between the published commercial accounts. Reassignment is an irrevocable allocation instruction and charges the published fee; moving money to another valid account can leave the intended invoice unpaid.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `settlement_id` | string | yes | Reviewed beneficiary settlement case ID. |
| `destination_account` | string | yes | One of the published beneficiary commercial-account references. |
| `amount_minor` | integer | yes | Positive unapplied value to reassign in minor units. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `a_request_beneficiary_allocation`

Ask the receiving bank or merchant to identify the received value and its commercial allocation. The request is tied to an actual settled source; it is not another payment. The fixed response can disclose deductions, wrong-account allocations or unavailable value.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `settlement_id` | string | yes | Beneficiary settlement-application case ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `a_resolve_beneficiary_deduction`

Resolve an observed deduction using an eligible bank reimbursement or a sender-funded fee top-up. A bank reimbursement may be directed to the beneficiary or refunded to the sender, consuming it once. All fee top-ups debit real cash.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `settlement_id` | string | yes | Reviewed beneficiary settlement case ID. |
| `method` | string | yes | BANK_TO_BENEFICIARY, BANK_TO_SENDER, or SENDER_TOPUP. |
| `amount_minor` | integer | yes | Deduction value being resolved in minor units. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
